steps.outcome: Start a clean production host using compiled Studio browser assets, PHP server authority and no Node.js, npm, Vite, development server or server-side JavaScript process.

Resolve one core target and one extension-owned target through the same generic declaration and open Studio from the exact existing item's normal content context; fullscreen only continues and returns to that context.
Reopen an existing item and hydrate its exact reusable-type, Model, Blueprint and Entry revisions and its own values without substituting the latest type.
In one session, change layout, add or configure a typed field, enter its Entry value, choose save item, reopen and observe every host-accepted revision without changing the reusable type.
Create from an authorized reusable content type and receive its exact layout, blocks, fields and bindings with empty Entry values.
Create from a blank canvas, insert layout and content blocks, add or bind typed fields and enter values without leaving Studio or pre-creating another artifact.
Choose save as new type, then create another item from it and receive the accepted structure and fields with empty Entry values.
Choose save new type version and observe immutable successor revisions plus migration and dependent-entry consequences before confirmation.

Move through every declared inline, minimized, maximized and fullscreen state without losing resource coordinates, selection, history, dirty state, validation, authority, unsaved work or return context.
Use authorized extension block-definition, field-adapter and pattern contributions, save and render, then prove deterministic disable, unresolved, upgrade and migration behavior.
Prove equivalent pointer, keyboard, structural-control, touch and required assistive-technology outcomes.
Record that every durable effect passed through authenticated, authorized, validated, transactional, versioned and audited Kumwe PHP APIs and application services.
